description: Read up to 5 public URLs in one call. Each URL returns its own status, final URL, title, main content as Markdown, truncated flag, byte and char counts and error code; one failing URL never fails the rest. Not charged if no URL can be read. Paid: $0.015 USDC per call via x402 on Base. Calling without payment returns the payment requirement; invalid input is not charged.

maxCharsPerUrl.description: Optional Markdown cap per URL, default 8,000.

name: web_read_batch
title: Read up to 5 web pages as Markdown
